## Quick Setup (30 Seconds)
1. Set this workflow as your instance **Error Workflow** (`Workflow Settings -> Error Workflow`) or call it as a Sub-Workflow when an AI Agent returns `[]` or invalid JSON.
2. The **Local Secret Scrubber** runs 100% inside your n8n instance and strips API keys (`sk_`, `ghp_`, `re_`, `whsec_`, JWTs, Bearer tokens, emails) BEFORE any alert leaves.
3. Connect your Slack, Telegram, Discord, or Email node to **Format Diagnostic Alert**.

Docs & Post-Mortems: https://hooktriage.com

## Security Audit Guarantee
- 100% Native n8n Nodes (`Error Trigger`, `Code`, `Set`)
- **Zero external HTTP calls by default** (your keys never leave your server)
- Detects both hard crashes and silent failures (empty arrays `[]`, HTTP `429` rate limits, `401/403` OAuth token deadlocks)
